# version role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:versionRole`](gmeow-versionRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/versionRole>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/versions`](../../slices/versions.md)

The role or status classification this membership asserts for the member within the set — canonical, variant, latest, stable, LTS, deprecated, yanked, draft, published, revised, collected, withdrawn. NON-FUNCTIONAL: an entity may hold multiple roles from different authorities simultaneously (standpoint-indexed coexistence per [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), and a role may change over time via new memberships rather than overwrite.
